key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Display Iris status and quick controls in the GNOME top bar.

key.name: show-on-lock-screen
key.summary: Show face-unlock hint on the lock screen
key.description: Display the scanning indicator on the unlock dialog. This is presentation only: whether face unlock actually works is decided by the PAM stack, not by this extension.

key.name: show-on-login-screen
key.description: Display the scanning indicator on the GDM greeter.

key.name: hint-timeout
key.summary: Seconds to show the scanning hint
key.description: How long the scanning animation runs before it settles into a neutral state. Match this to auth.timeout in /etc/iris/config.toml.

key.name: success-hold-ms
key.summary: Hold the unlock briefly on success
key.description: Milliseconds to keep the lock screen up after face authentication succeeds, so the success animation is visible. Without it the shell dismisses the screen the instant PAM returns and the checkmark is never seen. Applies only when nothing was typed; a typed password always unlocks immediately. 0 disables the hold.
